```plato

    // The Euler characteristic of the closed hull surface, which is 2 for any
    // non-degenerate convex hull; a different value means the mesh is not the
    // closed surface a hull should be. Edge count follows from the triangle
    // count on a closed triangulation (2E = 3F).
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Euler_characteristic)
    HullEulerCharacteristic(self: ConvexHull3D): Integer
        => self.HullVertexCount - self.HullFaceCount * 3 / 2 + self.HullFaceCount;
```
